title: Oran Park Townhome
summary: Full styling for a brand-new townhome — furniture, lighting and art selected to make a blank canvas feel like home from day one.
brief: New builds arrive as blank canvases, and this Oran Park townhome was no exception: white walls, good light, and not a stick of furniture.
The owners wanted a home that felt collected rather than catalogued. We styled every room — furniture, window treatments, lighting, art and objects — around a warm, golden palette.

photos.heading: The Living Room
photos.text: Gold drapery and sculptural lighting give the main living space its personality. Every piece was procured and placed as part of the engagement.

photos.heading: The Dining Room
photos.text: The dining room goes darker and moodier — timber battens, brass pendants and velvet seating for a space made for long dinners.

photos.heading: The Guest Bedroom
photos.text: Guest bedroom styled for Airbnb-readiness: durable layers, calm tones, and nothing precious.
